name: bestie-check
description: Check-before-handoff: prepare document deliverables with Bestie Check and read the free Claim and Assumption Quick Look. Invoke the bundled MCP server or npx -y @mybestie/check@0.4.0 only. Paid verification is offered only when the server opens it, and only against a quote the user approves. Never approve spend for the user.

interface.longDescription: Prepare a document deliverable with Bestie Check before returning it and read the free Claim and Assumption Quick Look: the claims it makes and the assumptions they rest on. Invoke MCP or npx -y @mybestie/check@0.4.0 only. Paid verification is offered only when the server opens it, and only against a quote the user approves. Plugins never approve spend.
defaultPrompt: Run check-before-handoff on this document deliverable before returning it.
Inspect capabilities, prepare the document, poll get_preparation, and report the Quick Look as returned.
